title: It’s Easy to Start a Private School. Take Our Quiz to Find Out Where You Can Open Yours.
summary: The post It’s Easy to Start a Private School. Take Our Quiz to Find Out Where You Can Open Yours. appeared first on ProPublica.
contentText:
Ever imagine yourself as a private school operator? It’s not such a wild idea. Hundreds of new private schools have popped up all over the country in recent years, responding to a surge of public money for students to pay tuition.

A team of ProPublica journalists has spent this year documenting how the American education landscape is shifting with an increased push for school privatization .

Our reporting has identified big differences in how states regulate who can run a school, what they must teach and where they can hold class. While some require new private school operators to prove they’re on the up-and-up, others invite anyone with a dream and a heartbeat to get into the business. ProPublica even founded a couple this year.

So why not you? Take our quiz on ProPublica’s website to find out which states might welcome you to open one with ease, no experience required.
